$purpose: Draft first-class media list for FRQNCY. Not wired into the live site yet.
$source: Extracted from content.json — 77 media entries across 74 unique names.

$creator_linking.notes: Media creators (hosts, publishers) are captured as strings when known. These are strong candidates for future people-bed expansion — Huberman, Tim Ferriss, Lex Fridman, etc.

$reconciliation_notes: Em-dash titles that were CREATOR-attributed (Masaru Emoto films, Sugata Mitra's project) were split — clean name is the work, creator is the person. Em-dash titles that were TOPICAL scoping (e.g., 'Quanta Magazine — Quantum', 'Our World in Data — Energy') kept the full title as-is — they represent specific sections/deep-links of larger publications and deserve their own entry.
